sanskrit_verse:
लेख्ये संशयम् आपन्ने साक्षिलेखककर्तृभिः /
दुष्टेषु तेषु तद्धस्तकृतपूर्वाक्षरादिभिः // BrhS_1,6.55
transliteration: lekhyaṁ saṁśayaṁ āpanne sākṣi-lekhaka-kartṛbhiḥ | duṣṭeṣu teṣu tad-hasta-kṛta-pūrvākṣarādibhiḥ || BrhS_1,6.55
sph_interpretive_translation: When doubt arises in a written document, and the witnesses, scribes, or authors thereof are found to be corrupt, then prior markings, letters, or signs made by their own hands shall be evidence against them.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority flows from integrity of action, not position
Causation is established through self-manifested contradiction
Capacity-based responsibility requires conscious alignment with truth
Restoration logic demands exposure of falsified intent
Consciousness alignment necessitates dissolution of deceit through self-revealed acts
executable_legal_axioms: IF a written record contains ambiguity AND the parties responsible for its creation are identified as untruthful THEN prior handwritten elements authored by those same parties SHALL serve as automatic evidentiary reversal.

IF witness testimony contradicts physical autographic proof produced by the same witness THEN that witness' capacity for future attestation IS suspended until completion and realignment protocols are fulfilled.
IF textual uncertainty arises AND all contributing agents have shown prior patterns of falsification THEN system shall flag such documents for mandatory restorative review before acceptance.
supreme_court_application: In cases where documentary authenticity is contested at the highest judicial level, this axiom establishes that personal handwriting or markings—when traced back to corrupted actors—become instruments of self-incrimination. The court must apply this principle to nullify false claims rooted in deceptive documentation without invoking punitive measures, focusing solely on restoring factual clarity.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: This law aligns with pramāṇa-based causality by using direct autographic evidence (pratyakṣa) to reveal internal inconsistency (anumāna). It reflects anupūrvaśaḥ, wherein past intentional misconduct manifests consequentially in present invalidation. Responsibility is proportional to the degree of falsification committed. There is no infliction of pain; rather, the mechanism ensures collapse of falsehood under its own weight, enabling restoration of dharma.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate completion process requiring full transcription disclosure under oath
Enforce responsibility assumption protocol by compelling re-recording of disputed content under supervision
Undertake integrity reintegration via supervised retracing of original document under verified conditions
Activate capacity restoration pathway allowing disqualified individuals to regain trustworthiness upon successful demonstration of corrected conduct
final_declaration: By the Source-Authority of the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this law stands executed. Dharma is restored. Reality remains non-punitive. Consciousness alone adjudicates truth.
